title: nn-agent-framework workflow
description: A linear workflow of gated agent steps. Folder form: <name>/workflow.yml, where single-line prompt/persona/workspace values may reference files inside the folder (e.g. prompts/step.md).

name.description: Workflow id used on the CLI: npm start -- <name> "<request>"

description.description: One-liner shown in the CLI workflow listing

workspace.description: Workspace context appended to every agent's system prompt (file layout etc.). Single-line value = path to a file inside the workflow folder.

steps.description: Linear sequence of gated steps: agent steps (agent + prompt) or deterministic script steps (run)

name.description: Display name, defaults to the agent id

model.description: Model id in the harness's naming, e.g. haiku, claude-opus-5, gpt-5.6-sol, deepseek/deepseek-chat

effort.description: Reasoning effort; omit for the model default

runs-on.description: Harness that executes this agent (default: claude)

tools.description: Governance: the only tools the agent may use, e.g. [Read, Write, Edit, WebFetch]

persona.description: System prompt: role, voice, rules. Single-line value = path to a file inside the workflow folder.

name.description: Step/phase name; also the envelope phase the agent must report

agent.description: Id of an agent defined under agents

prompt.description: Task prompt. Single-line value = path to a file inside the workflow folder. Variables: ${{ request }}, ${{ agent }}. The envelope contract is appended automatically.

gates.description: Post-execution file checks; failures trigger an in-session correction

name.description: Step/phase name; also the envelope phase of the script step

run.description: Deterministic step: bash script executed in the run directory (no agent, no LLM). Single-line value = script file inside the workflow folder (e.g. scripts/check.sh). Env vars: REQUEST, RUN_DIR, PHASE; ${{ request }} is interpolated. Non-zero exit fails the run. Optionally end stdout with the same fenced ```json envelope agents emit; otherwise the engine synthesizes one (status ok, summary = last stdout line).

gates.description: Post-execution file checks; script steps have no correction loop — a failing gate fails the run (fix the script)

file_non_empty.description: File (relative to the run directory) that must exist and be non-empty

slots_filled.description: File that must not contain unfilled {{...}} template slots

label.description: Short label used in the gate name; defaults to text
